propositions: JiraDataCenterTransport must implement TicketTransport, SupportsLinks, SupportsComments, and SupportsAbsenceProbe, returning raw payload dicts consumed by existing mappers, not jira.Issue objects
The transport is confined to an opt-in [jira-datacenter] extra imported lazily inside consuming functions, so rebar remains dependency-free and missing extras raise clear install-naming errors

Configuration from typed [tool.rebar.jira] must fail loudly on malformation rather than degrading to env-only JIRA_PAT, and HTTP errors are not retried while transient connectivity faults are retried with 2s/5s backoff mirroring acli_rest

TLS verification is never disabled (verify is never False); non-https base_url is rejected unless allow_insecure=true, ca_bundle configures internal CAs, and allow_insecure affects URL scheme check only, not certificate verification

Self-registration import in adapters/__init__.py must call register() so select_backend('jira-datacenter') resolves at runtime; absence of this import is undetectable by unit tests and only surfaces when operators first run

NameIdentity resolver's user-search lookup wired to live DC search_users via authoritative (name, True, False) return; unknown users raise BackendAssigneeNotFoundError on apply path while resolver returns (None, True, False) for authoritative-but-unmappable state
